name: Freedmen's Town Historic District
historical_address: Roughly bounded by Genesse, West Dallas, Arthur, and West Gray Streets, Houston, Texas
notes: A 40-block historic district in Houston's old Fourth Ward, founded just after emancipation on the southern banks of Buffalo Bayou. Listed on the National Register of Historic Places on January 17, 1985. By the second decade of the 20th century the broader community stretched from Buffalo Bayou south to Sutton Street and west from Milam and Travis Streets to Taft Street; the formally listed National Register boundary (per the state atlas) is narrower, roughly bounded by Genesse, West Dallas, Arthur, and West Gray Streets.
